title: Packet loss, burst outage and a node dropout
description: All nodes are moving. On top of the normal timeouts there is 5% random packet loss, and the N2-N3 link fails completely from 6 s to 8 s. N4 powers off from 10 s to 14 s: it sends no reports, and other nodes ranging to it record timeouts. When N4 comes back it has rebooted, so its seq counter restarts at 0.
expected_behaviour: System tolerates missing ranges without diverging (MVP 1.d)
N2-N3 link expires after 6 s and is restored at 8 s
N4 estimate marked degraded/stale during 10-14 s, recovers automatically (MVP 1.e)
Pipeline handles N4 seq reset to 0 after reboot
